notes.title: v1.04 Patch (July 5th)
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update: 

- Further tweaked the network connection settings to lessen the impact of lag between players.
- Troubleshoot for the cause of the numerous disconnection phenomenons. *To be further elaborated in a later notice.
- Further tweaked the Character Selection Memory feature for stability.
- Fixed a glitch where the semi-circle inputs (41236) were allowing missing inputs, causing an unintended shortcut and affecting gameplay.
- Fixed several English text errors.


Also, we have added the following new features to the game:

- A Connection Quality icon will now be displayed, when matched up with an opponent during Rank Match.
- Added a new filter to the Player Match with "MODERATELY", on top of the existing "BEGINNERS" and "PROS".
- Added a new Quick Message "Last game!" for use in Player Match.
- Added the Vertical Synchronization (a.k.a. V-Sync) feature to the game's Option menu. The default value is "OFF", and if players experience tremendous tearing for the game graphics, kindly try turning it to "ON".
- Added more scrolling functions in Network Ranking by pressing Left/Right.


We apologize for the long wait for this update.

notes.title: v1.02 Patch (Apr 26)
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update: 
- Added countermeasures to tackle the disconnections and incremental CPU usage during network play.
  *We are continuing to work on these issues. We seek your kind patience while we work on these matters.
- Fixed issue where controller input constantly feeds the "up" motion, for certain specific controllers.
- Fixed issue where the game crashes when the user uses a specific command move of a specific character.
- Fixed issue where the game consumes more CPU processing power than it is supposed to.
- Fixed several instances of English text.

New features:
- The game now remembers the latest user's selection - Character/Style/Color and several others, for Network Mode.


We are also continuing our investigation for the following issues:
- Certain computer AI do not perform as expected.
- Tremendous lag in Online gameplay.

notes.title: v1.01 Patch （Apr 21）
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update: 

- Added countermeasures to prevent the game from freezing/crashing during Network play.
- Added countermeasures to ease up the matchmaking.
- Fixed issue where the game crashes when the user has a profile name containing certain special characters.
- Fixed issue where rankings after the 30th place do not display properly.
- Fixed issue where the Player Match room names do not scroll properly.

Also, we have taken heed of the following issues and are working our best to fix them in the fastest time possible. We seek for your kind patience.
- Disconnections in Network play.
- Constant "up" input issue for certain controller setups
- Certain computer AI do not perform as expected

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
